# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old when Nell arrived at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed is an unusual-looking man with an awkward frame and hunching shoulders. He has long, iron-gray hair reaching to his shoulders and a thick, gentle brown beard that he has worn continuously since the age of twenty. His physical appearance at age sixty closely resembles his appearance at twenty, merely with somewhat more gray.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Obed is an exceptionally bashful, timid, and quiet man who harbors a deep fear of women and young girls, feeling uneasy that they might be secretly mocking him. Despite his shyness and social anxiety, he possesses a soft, tender heart and is easily charmed by affection. He habitually defers to his sister Thirza's authority, though he is capable of showing quiet determination and secret generosity when acting out of kindness for others.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c6 P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035), [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004)_

## Traits

- Bashful and extremely shy around women  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012)</sub>
- Fearful of women and young girls  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c6 P37](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0037)</sub>
- Tender-hearted and compassionate  <sub>[v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030), [v1 c6 P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)</sub>
- Submissive to his sister Thirza's decisions  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled negotiator for general farm supplies  <sub>[v1 c25 P5](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0005)</sub>
- Milking cows and general farm work  <sub>[v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>

## Goals

- To adopt and provide a good home for an orphan child at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032)</sub>
- To make Nell happy by gifting her a modern, fashionable dress for Christmas  <sub>[v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy traveled eight miles to Pale Sands Station at Alder River expecting to collect an orphan boy sent from Nova Scotia by Mrs. Alexander Tranter. Upon arriving, he discovered that a young eleven-year-old girl, Nell Harcourt, had been sent instead. Too bashful and overwhelmed to correct the mistake directly, he brought Nell home to Grey Shutters so his sister Thirza could resolve the situation. After learning of Nell's history and realizing she might be placed with Mrs. Scobie, Obed strongly advocated for keeping her. Later, noticing that Nell's plain wardrobe differed from her schoolmates' colorful and modern attire, Obed resolved to buy her a stylish dress for Christmas. Overcoming his fear of female store clerks, he ventured to Samuel Lawson's shop in Delford to purchase brown gloria fabric and asked Mrs. Sowerby to sew it into a fashionable gown with puffed sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032), [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P5](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0005), [v1 c25 P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025), [v1 c25 P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026)_

## Background by volume

- Grew his thick beard at the age of twenty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Resides at Grey Shutters in Brierley with his sister Thirza  <sub>[v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>
- Supports the Conservative political party and traditionally shops at William Blair's store  <sub>[v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006)</sub>

## Quotes

> A girl is not what I’m expecting. A boy is who I’ve come for. Here is where he should be. For me, Mrs. Alexander Tranter was supposed to bring him over from Nova Scotia.  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007)</sub>

> That Scobie woman wouldn't be given a dog I had any affection for.  <sub>[v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030)</sub>

> Ah, I figured you would end up viewing it that way, Thirza. Such an intriguing little creature she is.  <sub>[v1 c6 P33](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0033)</sub>

> Is there any—any—any—well, let’s say garden rakes available?  <sub>[v1 c25 P9](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0009)</sub>

> Well now, since you suggest it, I might as well—take—that is—look at—buy some—some hayseed.  <sub>[v1 c25 P12](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0012)</sub>
